statement: A reversal execution is a distinct execution event from its originating execution.
Reversal eligibility does not imply reversal authority.
A reversal cannot cross the consequential boundary without independent authority and admission.
Successful reversal does not erase historical occurrence of the originating execution.
Economic equivalence after reversal does not imply historical-state identity.
Technical reversibility does not imply governance authority to reverse.
The original execution and reversal execution remain separately reconstructable in historical lineage.
